Virtual business management

Get the right pieces in place.

From your first documented workflow to ongoing team and operations management, I help build a setup that fits how your business works.

Systems & workflows

Set up your CRM, write standard operating procedures, and create a management checklist that spells out what gets done, by whom, and when.

Hiring & virtual assistance

Identify where support is needed, recruit virtual assistants for the right specialty, and create a clear onboarding and handoff process.

Daily operations & sales

Coordinate team meetings and communications, manage follow-ups, and handle payroll and ongoing tasks as agreed.

About
